- Single shareholder holds 61.11%

**Overview:**  
Jaya Mega Consulting Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited firm offering architectural design and planning services in Selangor, Malaysia. It was incorporated on 19 April 2018 and currently has four directors, with the largest shareholder owning 61.11% of the equity. Reported revenues are RM29,763,571, RM31,119,761 and RM33,648,817 across the three most recent financial periods, with equity of RM24,611,141, RM26,363,907 and RM28,881,892 respectively. No net‑profit, audit opinion or current‑ratio data are provided.
